Market today: Rates are the big story, with the 30-year Treasury yield hitting a 19-year high. This is the real driver for your tech/chip names, which are sensitive to borrowing costs.

Your holdings: SOXL is a SELL at -40.45% and SPAL is NEW at -34.1%. Both are leveraged ETFs that decay, and your margin amplifies drops. CRWD is up 18.92%, QQQ up 2.13%, SPY up 5.21%, SMH down -6.65%, and QQQI down -1.17%.

Watch: Keep an eye on the semiconductor ETF SMH and your leveraged plays like SOXL and SPAL as rates move.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and the impact of rising rates on your concentrated tech book.
plays: SOXL: SELL/TRIM. It's marked SELL and is down significantly. Consider reducing exposure.
SPAL: SELL/TRIM. It's marked NEW but is down sharply. Given leverage and decay, consider trimming.
Consider NVDA: ACCUMULATE 8/12. Entry 224.78-224.56, stop 224.22. Backed by scanner setup.
